title: Hatsune Miku — Where Could The Big Shell Be?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Where Could The Big Shell Be?（3★）

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hum-humm♪
I had so much fun at the Seaside School today.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hi, Miku! I've hardly seen you at all today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. It sounds like you're in a really good mood too♪ Did something nice happen?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I got to hang out with Emu at the Seaside School☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The Seaside School? What's that...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a wonderful event where you get to go to the beach and have fun with your friends.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The beach?! No fair, Miku!
I wanna go to the beach too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too!! Me too!!
Why didn't you tell us that you were going?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Sorry, guys!
I heard that you'd both be busy with a show so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I do feel a little bad about going all by myself...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But Emu did say that she wanted to share whatever fun she has with everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
Wait here, okay♪
Seaside School - Day 2
Beach

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wow...! Len, look!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa...! It's the ocean!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<It's so pretty and sparkly!
It just goes on and on and on...!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! It's a lot bigger than I expected!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thanks for doing this for us, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're super welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, Emu, thanks so much!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But is it okay for you to go out all alone like this?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup. It's still really early, and my group said that they'd come and get me when it's time for breakfast!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So we can hang out until then!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay! Awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then let's have as much fun as we can!>

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hey, Emu...
Is seawater really as salty as everyone says it is?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's really really salty!
I'll get some in my mouth sometimes while I'm swimming and it'll make me go, Blargh!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Really...?
I kinda want to taste it and see if it's as salty as you say it is.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Emu! Emu!
Did you see any fish when you went swimming?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh yeah!
There's all sorts of pretty fish in the ocean, right?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I saw lots of little fishies!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<You did...?!
I wish I could've seen them.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Me too♪
But we probably shouldn't go in the water, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. Emu would have to take her phone into the ocean, which probably won't end well...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. No need to worry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-daah! With this handy-dandy zipper baggie, I can take my phone with me into the ocean!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: <Cool!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <R-Really?!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! First, in goes my phone. Then we zip it up as tightly as we can...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we throw it into another one just to be safe, close it up tightly too...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And there we go! My phone can go into the ocean now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's so cool! I didn't know they made bags like that!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually, another girl in my group brought some snacks in one of these!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We ate everything that was inside, so she said that I could have it♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's so nice of her!
We should find a way to thank her later!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hey, Emu, Miku!
Let's get in the water already!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, let's go☆ I can't wait any longer☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, let me just take my socks off and tie off my clothes so they don't get wet...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright, here we go!
Get ready to dive!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How is it? Can you see anything...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah! It's beautiful down here!
You can see for miles and miles!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <She's right! But I'm not seeing any fish...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait, there! I saw one at two-o-clock!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really? Okay!
Mr. Fishy, here I come!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm glad we asked Emu to do that for us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I sort of also feel like we just been taking and didn't give anything back.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then why don't we come up with something that Emu will really love♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Something she'd really love?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I already have a plan ready. Wanna help me make it happen?

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, then let's get right to it♪
